tasks.label: Build Imp Lab (Windows)
tasks.detail: Cross-compile portable imp-lab.exe plus the Aura pack (aura-editor config + UI library, aura-engine dlls) via editor-windows (cargo-xwin + Bun) into AURA_EDITOR_WIN_OUT (/out). Needs WebView2 on Windows. Requires Dev Container rebuild for docker-outside-of-docker.

tasks.label: Assemble Aura pack (Linux)
tasks.detail: Build the aura-engine pack cdylibs and the aura-editor UI library in the imp-lab service and assemble the Aura pack into .aura-pack/ (run Imp Lab with IMP_LAB_EXTENSIONS=/workspaces/aura-workbench/.aura-pack/extensions.json).
